x-poly-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY: Seven UTC days, counted back from the window's end.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_24_HOURS: The last 24 hours: 24 hourly buckets, ending at the end of the current UTC hour.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_26_WEEKS: The last 26 weeks: 26 weekly buckets of 7 days, ending at the end of the current UTC day.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_30_DAYS: The last 30 days: 30 daily buckets, ending at the end of the current UTC day.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_7_DAYS: The last 7 days: 7 daily buckets, ending at the end of the current UTC day.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LAST_90_DAYS: The last 90 days: 90 daily buckets, ending at the end of the current UTC day.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List completed QuickSwaps of every broker, newest first, by source or destination asset.

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps to this destination asset and network, as a zipped asset ID; omit for every destination.
parameters.name: destinationZippedAssetId

parameters.description: Maximum number of QuickSwaps to return; 0 means 50, at most 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous nextPageToken, exclusive, bound to the asset filters and the newest-first order. Omit for the first page.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps from this source asset and network, as a zipped asset ID; omit for every source.
parameters.name: sourceZippedAssetId

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, or PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID: a pageToken that is malformed or from other filters.

429.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: the client address exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: INTERNAL: an internal error; retry the same request.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: retry the same request.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Get totals, a time series and per-route totals of completed QuickSwaps of every broker over a window.

parameters.description: The window: the last 24 hours in hourly buckets, the last 7, 30 or 90 days in daily buckets, or the last 26 weeks in weekly buckets, each ending at the end of the current bucket.
parameters.name: window

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: no window, or an unknown one.

429.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: the client address exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: STATS_INCOMPLETE: a completed QuickSwap in the window lacks its deposited or delivered amount (swapId names it); INTERNAL: an internal error.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: retry the same request.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
